(1) game/src/ui/screens/progress.js, drawLevelUp() and drawSheet(): lay the attribute row out as three DISJOINT fractions of its own rect instead of the old fixed offsets — a name column, a right-aligned value column, and a gauge that starts at x >= name_w + value_w. (2) game/src/ui/screens/text.js, drawJournal(): the paging loop breaks a column only when the running height plus the block exceeds colH AND the column is already non-empty, so a block TALLER than colH is placed anyway and overflows — colH is ih - 30*s = 294 units and a wrapped entry at colW 140 px is about 397. Either split a block across columns or reduce the entry's own height to fit. (3) game/src/ui/screens/inventory.js and text.js: the container and spells foot hints must wrap or shrink to the panel's inner width instead of running off it. MY OWN INSTRUMENT DEFECTS, RECORDED RATHER THAN SHIPPED AS FINDINGS. (1) tools/ui/t4-r4-critic.mjs's first run read the input-attach flag at eng.input.real.attached instead of eng.real.attached and omitted setMode('play-instrumented'), so it reported I0 false and then hung; both were fixed and the run repeated. (2) THE IMPORTANT ONE: that script's page.screenshot() frames came back BYTE-IDENTICAL to one another — tools/visual/frame-liveness.mjs reported DUPLICATE on 3 of 4 — because the probe runs with setRenderRate(0) and the page's presented buffer does not advance. Every pixel number its OVERLAP leg printed was therefore VOID. Its ELEMENT RECTS are sound (getUIState() self-reports; the game state was correct), so the rects were kept and the pixels recomputed offline in tools/ui/t4-r4-critic-overlap.mjs against t4-r2-measure.mjs captures, which go through canvas.toDataURL() and which frame-liveness passes as LIVE. This is exactly why the brief mandated frame-liveness on every frame.

The overlap metric itself went through one discarded design, and the discard is evidence too. A colour heuristic classifying 'ink' as dark-and-low-chroma and 'gauge' as green failed twice: the level-up gauge plate is (42,55,43) and misses `G > B + 12` by one unit, and the CHARACTER SHEET's own panel ground is (44,57,45) — the same colour — so 'dark and low chroma' matched the background and reported 73% of a row as ink. The shipped metric uses RI-UIX09's own definition of foreground (a pixel more than 24 rgb from the PANEL's modal colour) and counts separators. It still under-reports on the sheet, which is stated in the verdict rather than hidden.

The delete-the-fix worktree is SPARSE (`git sparse-checkout set game tools`, tools/node_modules symlinked) because the box has 3.2 GB free and a full checkout is about 10 GB. It is a real worktree at a real pinned sha running the real tools; what it could not do is run the two scripts that import t4-r2-critic-measure.mjs's own default manifest, which is why the control arm has captures and density but no per-row element rects — the control evidence for the layout regression is therefore the CROP rather than a number.
